text:
mira: quick find from the monthly least-priv run: a KMS key in prod with a project-scoped binding to analytics-project. looks accidental. tagging eng-security. :mag:

kevin: which key? can you paste the binding snippet?

mira: key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/etl/cryptoKeys/etl-key
binding: members: ["project:analytics-project"] role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

ash: that will give too-wide decrypt rights. run the IAM policy simulator for the analytics identity and list recent Decrypt audit log events on that key.

mira: running now. simulator shows analytics-project has Decrypt on the key. audit log last decrypt: 2026-03-29T04:12:15Z by serviceAccount:migration-sa@analytics.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sec-bot: Alert INC-2026-89 created: KMS project-scoped principal detected for etl-key. See runbook: /runbooks/kms-bindings

kevin: likely TF module added project principal instead of SA. @infra-owners please confirm PRs touching the module in last 72h.

oncall: oncall here. If this is a mistaken binding we should scope it and canary test. I can approve emergency patch during low traffic window.

mira: proposed steps: 1) snapshot current policy 2) remove project principal and add specific SA binding 3) smoke ETL job in staging 4) rotate any SA keys if we see unexpected decrypts

ash: also add a log-based alert for SetIamPolicy on that key and a tflint rule to prevent project:* principals in that module. I'll open RFC for policy-as-code afterward.

kevin: PR 7810 to scope binding opened. will run canary tonight. thanks mira for catching.

sec-bot: INC-2026-89 status: investigating -> mitigation pending. assignee: kevin

mira: update: canary passed in staging, PR merged to prod with scoped SA, added alert. closing incident and filing postmortem stub.

oncall: system checks green. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
